Synopsis:
Meta settled an $18B multi-state lawsuit over children's social media addiction, agreeing to enhanced (but not strict) age verification, daily usage limits, and nighttime notification disabling for under-18 users. The settlement navigates COPPA constraints by avoiding hard ID checks while requiring proactive detection methods, independent auditing, and AI-assisted under-13 identification. A parallel $942M New Mexico judgment reinforces the same framework.
